description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget, a stateful Flutter widget responsible for displaying user authentication status, performing a protected API call, and providing logout and lock functionalities.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the home screen with options to call protected API endpoints, logout, and lock the app.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: The state class for HomeScreen, managing UI state, loading indicators, and interactions.

methods.name: _callProtected
methods.description: Asynchronously calls a protected API endpoint (_callProtected) and updates UI state based on the response.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the HomeScreen widget, including buttons for protected API call, logout, and lock, and displaying status messages.
